=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3040-3052 (`_inject_token_into_url`), lines 3077-3083 (`_resolve_origin_url`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: HTTPS Git URLs embed `GH_TOKEN`/`GH_PAT` instead of using command-scoped `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git configuration, diagnostics, logs, and remote URLs, reintroducing the credential-leak the prior authentication boundary prevented.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: Lines 581-585 (`_memory_force_tick_remote_url`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds `GH_TOKEN`/`GH_PAT` directly in the returned HTTPS remote URL.
  WHY: Force-tick clone, fetch, and push operations expose the PAT through argv, Git configuration, diagnostics, and logs.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: Lines 151-153 and 180 (in `memory_ensure_branch`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote` and `git push` no longer use the deleted `_memory_git` authentication wrapper.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, private-repository branch checks and pushes run unauthenticated and the `ai-memory` branch is not initialized.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: Line 670 (the codex exec invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose Codex invocation bypasses the model-provider broker and uses `--sandbox danger-full-access` on issue-derived input.
  WHY: The model can access ambient `GH_TOKEN`/`OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and mutate the workspace; this is a credential and trust-boundary regression.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: Removed constants/functions at former lines 152-172 (`MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, `is_sensitive_target_path`), and `normalize_path` at line 240-247 no longer calls them | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count/path-length limits were removed.
  WHY: Plan- or issue-derived paths can inline `.git`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, and other credential-bearing files into model prompts.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: Lines 43-140 and the entire deleted broker block that previously occupied lines 143-522 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while live workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Brokered plan, implement, validate, review, audit, and orchestration phases fail with command-not-found or lose credential isolation.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Deleted functions `review_blocked_decision_digest`, `review_blocked_find_pending_request`, `review_blocked_build_approval_request`, `review_blocked_approval_status`, `review_blocked_post_approval_request`, `review_blocked_post_consumed_marker`, `review_blocked_find_issue_for_request`, `review_blocked_build_successor_intent`, `review_blocked_successor_marker`, `review_blocked_ensure_successor_intent`, `review_blocked_resolve_successor_issue`, `review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue` and `git_with_github_auth` (formerly lines ~493-498 and ~947-1370) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval/successor APIs and authenticated Git helpers were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Terminal decisions, approval flows, successor issue handling, and authenticated baseline pushes fail with command-not-found.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: Lines 95-110 (argument parsing, removed `--provider-base-url` case) and line 261 (hard-coded `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--provider-base-url` interface was removed and the provider URL was hard-coded.
  WHY: Existing callers exit on the unknown argument, while hard-coding the public endpoint bypasses the broker loopback URL.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: Lines 62-67 (removed `--provider-base-url` case from `codex_config_assemble`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` also rejects the removed `--provider-base-url` option.
  WHY: Restoring the writer alone would not repair callers because the assembler fails first.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Lines 49-54 (removed `--process-group-file` option parsing case) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--process-group-file` CLI option was removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes it.
  WHY: Editor-isolation launches exit with an unknown-option error before starting the editor.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Lines 127-132 (python3-unavailable fallback path) and deleted process-group identity/verification logic (former lines 287-351) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing Python now falls through to direct execution, and process-group identity, metadata, and survivor verification were removed.
  WHY: Isolated editors can run without heartbeat, kill-on-stall, or safe descendant cleanup; severity disagreement: deepseek, minimax, and qwen classify the related runtime failures as blocker, while minimax separately classified orphan cleanup as major.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Lines 766-772 (REST transform) and lines 913-924 (GraphQL transform) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval logic cannot authenticate producer comments or authorize approvers.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: Lines 101-237 (staged-support restore block) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow or script produces them.
  WHY: The guard is dead and self-repository implement runs can still overwrite branch-owned helpers with staged immutable-reference copies.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-82 (the "Configure git auth for memory helper clones" step) vs. lines 88-130 (the "Fetch memory helper scripts" step that runs `memory_ensure_branch` via staged helpers) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_*` authentication exports are scoped to one GitHub Actions step and do not persist to later memory-helper steps.
  WHY: Later Git operations use an unauthenticated HTTPS origin despite `persist-credentials: false`, causing memory branch initialization to fail.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: Lines 536-716 (rewritten `emit_context`), specifically the markers at lines 576-579, 642-650, 668-676, and 678-681 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `emit_context` does not count headers, missing-file markers, overflow markers, or binary-skip markers against `used_bytes`, and has no path-count cap.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can exceed `max_bytes` and model context budgets by an unbounded marker and path-processing amount.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-38 (module imports), lines 714-781 (sensitive-path and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap tests) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing tests import deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, blocking the targeted-file-context test module.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Lines 412-462 (post-signal handling and `finally`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup falls back to killing the recorded process group without waiting for it to become empty or verifying descendants stopped.
  WHY: Orphaned editor descendants may retain secrets, file descriptors, and staged support files.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: Lines 568-684 (path loop) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Removing `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` makes the context loop process every supplied path and large file.
  WHY: Excessive path and file processing can routinely exceed prompt budgets and slow autofix iterations.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 4-75 (new staged-support branch) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support branch does not validate that `SSB_REASON` and `SSB_FILES` are non-empty before posting diagnostics.
  WHY: It can publish an empty or misleading failure comment and Telegram message without actionable conflicting-file data.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 129-132 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The missing-Python fallback no longer records an `unguarded` state and propagates the child result as if normally supervised.
  WHY: Callers cannot distinguish an unsupervised editor run from a clean guarded exit.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 127-132 (python3-unavailable fallback path) and deleted process-group identity/verification logic (former lines 287-351) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Missing Python now allows an isolated editor to run without stall detection or process-group verification.
  WHY: Orphaned editor processes cannot be safely identified or terminated.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
